text: This application proposes to amend the Official Plan to add a Site and Area-Specific Policy ("SASP") for the property at 1966 to 2050 Eglinton Avenue East and 50 Thermos Road (see Attachment 1: Location Map) to permit a mixed-use development including new public streets and parkland. The existing low-rise retail buildings, with a total gross floor area of 31,451 square metres, would be demolished. The subject lands are located within the Golden Mile Secondary Plan area ("GMSP area") approved through Official Plan Amendment No. 499 ("OPA 499"), and are also subject to new Golden Mile Urban Design Guidelines, as adopted by City Council on October 30, 2020.
